subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “At night, light shone through the windows and made the drawings appear on the ground.”?
options: Many visitors stopped to look at it because it was different.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「At night, light shone through the windows and made the drawings appear on the ground. Visitors stopped to look.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Many visitors stopped to look at it because it was different.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Some visitors were afraid.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Some visitors liked it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「At night, light shone through the windows and made the drawings appear on the ground. Visitors stopped to look.」，答案為「Visitors stopped to look.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Visitors stopped to look.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
